name: auto-coding
description: Unattended development supervisor: Worker turn -> decision -> acceptance checks -> independent review -> repair or done; merges and releases are blocked.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Model for the independent review of each candidate.

maxTurns.title: Max turns
maxTurns.description: Turns per task: every main-loop turn that ends during it, repair turns and turns that end while paused included; past it the task is verified once and ends.

maxRepairRounds.title: Max repair rounds
maxRepairRounds.description: Repair turns sent after failed checks or a revise verdict before the task is parked as blocked.

deadlineMinutes.title: Deadline (minutes)
deadlineMinutes.description: Wall-clock budget per task; past it no new turn starts, the work is verified and the task ends.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated; a trailing * matches a prefix (release/*). Merging into them or pushing them directly is denied.

publish.title: After a passing review
publish.description: none keeps a verified local candidate; push has the Worker push its branch; pr also opens a pull request (never merged).
